parts.label: Free wave number k₀
parts.help: m, E and ℏ positive; principal positive wave number.

parts.label: Wave number k₂y
parts.help: Conserved tangential momentum; k₀ > 0; incidence angle in radians, 0 ≤ θ < π/2.

parts.label: Barrier decay parameter κ
parts.help: V₀ > E > 0; m, ℏ > 0; real positive decay constant; θ in radians.

parts.label: Transmitted wave number k₃x
parts.help: Positive-x transmitted wave; k₀ > 0; 0 ≤ θ < π/2 in radians.

parts.label: Transmission probability
parts.help: Use E_x = E cos²θ > 0 and κ from part (c); V₀ > E_x, d > 0. This form uses the normal energy, not total E.

parts.label: Square-box escape-rate approximation λ
parts.help: a ≫ d; independent collisions and small escape probability. κ₄₅ = √(2m(V₀ − E/2))/ℏ. Count all four wall collisions; all length/energy/mass scales positive.
